metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-94. - House numbers.
content.summary:
The city engineer shall assign each house its proper number. The city engineer shall
               cause to be prepared, from time-to-time, a map of the streets of the city, showing
               all houses and the numbers applicable thereto.
(Code 1960, § 21-14; Code 1981, § 30-104)
